original_query: Which Activity is undertaken by more smartphone users, Email services or Social networks?

summaries.found_via_query: Which activity is used more by smartphone users: email services or social networks?
summaries.summary: The slide presents smartphone usage insights in Romania, showing that 88% of users engage with social networks, compared to 70% for email services. It also includes additional statistics on app usage, TV watching while using smartphones, and user preferences regarding devices.
key_facts: 88% of smartphone users use social networks
70% of smartphone users use email services
79% of smartphone owners would never leave home
33% would rather give up their TV than their smartphone
32% of SP owners watch TV while using the SP
visible_text: 79% of smartphone owners would never leave home :)
